{{Top|leg}}
The '''Eskellon Mountains''' was a large mountain range which straddled the southern coast of [[Alanciar]], a continent on the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] planet of [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. In [[2975 BBY]], the [[Alanciari]] [[Wardmaster]] [[Quarra Thayn]] and the [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith Tribe]] [[High Lord]] [[Edell Vrai]] traveled through these mountains while on the way to [[Kerebba]] and [[Sus'mintri]], the capital of Alanciar.
